tools.name: nyria_send_alert
tools.description: Send a trade alert to your Nyria strategy. The alert is parsed and forwarded to every bot on the strategy. If the strategy has live bots, this places real orders in your broker account, exactly like the webhook; the alert also reaches accounts that copy the strategy. Preview first when unsure. Alert

tools.name: nyria_preview_alert
tools.description: Parse a trade alert without placing any orders. Use this to verify your alert message will be interpreted correctly before sending it live. JSON alerts with order keys (order_type, stop_price, limit_price, trail_percent, trail_amount, stop_loss, stop_loss_limit, take_profit, percent, bots) and the F

tools.name: nyria_strategy_info
tools.description: Show the strategy this connection sends to: name, status, equity type and active bot count.

tools.name: nyria_recent_orders
tools.description: View recent orders placed through your strategy. Shows order_id, instrument, action, status, quantity, price, and timestamp. Pass an order_id to nyria_order_status for its fill.

tools.name: nyria_list_bots
tools.description: List bots deployed on your strategy. Shows each bot's broker, account type (live or paper), status, and position size.

tools.name: nyria_positions
tools.description: Show open positions on each broker account that has a bot on this strategy: account (last 4 digits), instrument, side, filled quantity and average price. Covers positions Nyria opened; trades placed outside Nyria are not listed.

tools.name: nyria_order_status
tools.description: Look up an order by the order_id from nyria_send_alert or nyria_recent_orders. Shows each bot's order: status, quantity, filled quantity, fill price, broker and account type.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: nyria_preview_alert · Public sink: nyria_send_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: nyria_preview_alert · Public sink: nyria_send_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
